fontEvidence.processing: Static weight 400 instance generated with fonttools 4.60.1: python -m fontTools.varLib.instancer NotoSansCJKsc-VF.ttf wght=400 -o NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.ttf. Retains all source glyphs; TrueType outlines avoid CFF subset glyph loss in PDF export. Re-save with font["glyf"].padding=4 before bundling; fontkit 1.1.1 subset short loca requires even glyph offsets.

findings: All seven script samples visibly rendered; Japanese glyph pixel assertions guard silent subset loss.
Rotated translated baseline follows the cropped source page.
Real English scan OCR exports readable searchable text; slight glyph repair remnants may remain.

PDF-lib 1.17.1: exported field edit and reload
Chromium DOMParser and createImageBitmap: exported XML/resources
limitations: Synthetic independently authored corpus; deterministic translations validate mechanics, not linguistic quality.
Standalone corpus bundles source modules; separate app cases execute the built extension interface.
PDF.js exact copy/search ordering differs for RTL words with trailing digits and Indic combining marks; attached semantic HTML retains exact logical Unicode.
Translated backgrounds are rasterized; original bilingual pages retain native vector objects.
Dense texture repair, ambiguous/skewed layout and unusual form appearances require review.
No Word/LibreOffice layout, EPUBCheck/reader pagination, PDF/UA, handwriting, mobile/Safari or commercial export equivalence claim.
Encrypted inputs require a locally unlocked copy; scan OCR is qualified here only for crisp printed English.
